items.title: Automated frontend verification
steps: Run npm run typecheck.
Run npm --prefix frontend run lint.
Run npm --prefix frontend run build.
Run npm run test:notifications.
Search frontend source for object-cover, object-fit: cover, and background-size: cover; confirm any remaining crop-to-fill rule is an approved circular identity-avatar surface.
items.expected: All commands succeed with no errors caused by this change. Full content photos have no crop-to-fill rule; the approved circular identity-avatar surfaces and compact multi-photo carousel previews are the only crop-to-fill exceptions.
items.evidence: 2026-08-20: frontend typecheck and production build passed after R1-R4 fixes. Frontend lint completed with the same six pre-existing warnings outside this change. Root package has no check:all script, so the documented frontend gates were run directly.
items.notes: The production build retains its pre-existing large-chunk advisory.

items.title: Post and shared-post media show every image edge
items.precondition: Signed in; portrait, landscape, and square posts are available, including a multi-photo and shared post.
steps: Inspect regular feed posts, profile timeline posts, and their detail views.
Inspect multi-photo grids, a shared-post embed, and the photo-comments page.
Repeat portrait checks at a narrow/mobile viewport.
items.expected: Full post-detail and photo-comment media is complete and uses natural height with no extra surrounding panel or nested album border; tall images shrink within a viewport-safe area. Multi-photo previews show the original fixed four-tile grid and a +N overlay on the fourth tile; opening the post exposes every original image.
items.evidence: 2026-08-20: Recheck required after R4 removed the shared-post media stage.
items.notes: Verify the shared original media no longer receives an extra muted panel.

items.title: Comment and composer photos show every image edge
items.precondition: Signed in; have a comment image and files of all three orientations ready to attach.
steps: Inspect an existing image comment.
Attach portrait, landscape, and square photos in the post composer and comment composer.
Confirm thumbnail labels, remove controls, and submission behavior.
items.expected: Existing comment media and selected attachment thumbnails show all edges; composer interactions remain unchanged.
items.evidence: 2026-08-20: Recheck required after R3 changed the comment attachment to a bounded contained thumbnail stage.
items.notes: Verify portrait, landscape, and square comment attachments remain contained and the remove control works.

items.title: Message photos and reply previews show every image edge
items.precondition: Signed in with a conversation containing image-only and captioned image messages.
steps: Inspect landscape and portrait message bubbles.
Open the image viewer.
Reply to an image and inspect its quote strip and composer preview.
items.expected: No message, reply, or composer preview crops image content; the existing viewer still opens the complete image.
items.evidence: 2026-08-20: Recheck required after R1/R2 restored the chat-local lightbox and its 220px by 12rem media rail.
items.notes: Verify Messenger-dark with app-light, portrait/landscape media caps, and Escape/backdrop dismissal.

items.title: Profile covers show every image edge; avatars remain circular
items.precondition: Signed in with portrait and landscape avatar and cover files ready for preview or update.
steps: Inspect avatars in the navbar, feed, comments, friends, and messages.
Inspect a profile-header cover and the full profile-picture dialog.
Open profile edit and photo-update previews for portrait and landscape files.
items.expected: Cover photos show every image edge with neutral unused space rather than crop. Avatars and profile-picture activity remain circular and centered, with no extra square backdrop.
items.evidence: 2026-08-20: Recheck required after R1 moved the cover-update preview dimensions from the image to its stage.
items.notes: Verify h-44 / sm:h-52 cover preview sizing and contained portrait/landscape images.

items.title: Future uploads and frontend verification gate
steps: Create new post, comment, message, and cover uploads with mixed orientations.
Verify each new content upload follows the no-crop rule without special settings.
Update an avatar and confirm it stays circular without a square backdrop.
Run npm --prefix frontend run typecheck.
Run npm --prefix frontend run lint.
Run npm --prefix frontend run build.
items.expected: The no-crop rule applies automatically to future content uploads; avatars retain the approved circular profile treatment; and all frontend commands finish without errors caused by this change.
items.evidence: 2026-08-20: Automated gates reran successfully; the affected comment, message, and cover visual checks remain pending.
items.notes: Complete T1-T4 before marking this end-to-end item passed.

items.title: Post and profile photos open their selected full image
items.precondition: Signed in with a profile avatar and single- and multi-photo posts available in the feed, shared-post embed, and post-detail view.
steps: Click the profile-header avatar and confirm its close-up opens without changing the avatar’s circular presentation.
Click the circular image in a profile-picture update post and confirm the same close-up opens.
As the profile owner, use the separate camera control and confirm change, view, and remove options remain available.
Click a single post photo or a multi-photo carousel, including the fourth tile with a +N overlay.
Confirm the post-detail album opens.
Click several individual album photos, then close the dialog with the X, backdrop click, and Escape.
items.expected: Both the profile-header avatar and the circular image in a profile-picture update post open the same immersive circular view at the browser viewport level, with no surrounding dialog card, visible text, ring, halo, or drop shadow. Its plain X sits on the photo’s upper-right edge and there is no footer Close button. The backdrop is black and blurred in dark mode. Profile-owner photo actions remain available from the camera control. The feed/post preview opens the album first. Clicking an album photo then opens that selected image in the browser viewport center, independently of the album animation. Desktop retains the 28rem cap; mobile uses reduced 80vw by 64dvh bounds; neither crops, adds a title, border, or padding. The small plain X is anchored inside the photo’s upper-right edge with no surrounding circle or outline, turns black on a light photo area and white on a dark one; the backdrop is black and blurred in dark mode; backdrop click and Escape dismiss it.
items.evidence: 2026-08-19: User completed local acceptance for the profile-header and profile-update viewers, including their matching viewport presentation, plain X controls, dark-mode black blur, and responsive photo behavior.
